nodes.label: Adjust Filters
nodes.short_def: Tune position windows, mover thresholds, and value cutoffs.
nodes.why_important: Right thresholds prevent both overreaction and missed opportunities.

nodes.label: Ahrefs (Rank Tracker + Audit)
nodes.short_def: Cross-check visibility/movers, plus weekly site audit and backlink deltas.
nodes.why_important: Provides sanity signals and tech/authority diagnostics that rankings alone cannot explain.

nodes.label: Audit Content Quality
nodes.short_def: Assess E-E-A-T signals, content depth, freshness, and competitive positioning.
nodes.why_important: Google rewards content that demonstrates expertise, experience, and trustworthiness.
nodes.deep_dive: Checks: author attribution, credentials visibility, content depth vs competitors, recency of information, citation quality, and user engagement signals.
nodes.example: Finds pricing page content outdated (references 2024 data) - creates refresh work order.
nodes.eli5: Making sure your content deserves to rank higher than competitors.

nodes.label: Audit On-Page SEO
nodes.short_def: Check titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and keyword targeting.
nodes.why_important: On-page elements directly signal relevance to search engines and affect CTR.
nodes.deep_dive: Checks: title length and keyword placement, meta description completeness, H1 uniqueness and alignment, heading hierarchy, internal link distribution, and anchor text quality.
nodes.example: Finds H1 "Every Missed Call Is a Lost Patient" missing primary keyword "medical answering service" - creates content fix work order.
nodes.eli5: Making sure each page clearly tells Google what it is about.

nodes.label: Audit Technical SEO
nodes.short_def: Check crawlability, indexation, site speed, mobile-friendliness, and security.
nodes.why_important: Technical issues can completely block rankings regardless of content quality.
nodes.deep_dive: Checks: robots.txt blocks, sitemap completeness, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), render-blocking resources, HTTPS, canonical tags, and structured data validity.
nodes.example: Finds sitemap missing lastmod dates - crawl efficiency reduced - creates tech fix work order.
nodes.eli5: Making sure Google can actually find and read your pages.

nodes.label: Authority + Publishing Throttle
nodes.short_def: When to build linkable assets and when to slow publishing due to regressions.
nodes.why_important: Authority plateaus and tech/conversion regressions require changing strategy, not more random posts.

nodes.label: Burst Drip Publish
nodes.short_def: Schedule bursts over multiple days instead of publishing all at once.
nodes.why_important: Spreads risk and makes outcomes measurable per day.

nodes.label: Burst: Multiple Spokes
nodes.short_def: Create 3–5 supporting posts when a cluster is poised to reach top 10.
nodes.why_important: A burst increases topical coverage and internal link support at the moment it matters most.

nodes.label: CTR/Conversion Tracking
nodes.short_def: Identify top-10 queries that underperform in clicks or conversions.
nodes.why_important: Triggers snippet fixes and publishing slowdowns when needed.

nodes.label: CTR: Snippet Fix
nodes.short_def: Update title/meta and add FAQ blocks to improve clicks when ranking is already top 10.
nodes.why_important: Better CTR can improve traffic immediately and sometimes improves rankings via engagement signals.

nodes.label: Cannibalization Consolidation
nodes.short_def: Resolve keyword ranking URL flips by picking a winner and merging/redirecting/canonicalizing.
nodes.why_important: Cannibalization splits authority and confuses search engines, slowing progress.

nodes.label: Commit + Open PR
nodes.short_def: Package the change as a single, reviewable PR.
nodes.why_important: Clear PRs keep shipping stable and isolate regressions.

nodes.label: Compare to Audit Baseline
nodes.short_def: Diff current findings against previous audit to identify changes.
nodes.why_important: Tracking issue persistence helps prioritize fixes and measure improvement over time.
nodes.deep_dive: Maintains history of findings. New issues get immediate attention. Persistent issues (>2 weeks) escalate in priority. Resolved issues are logged for success tracking.
nodes.example: Same missing meta on /pricing/ flagged 3 weeks in a row - priority elevated from Medium to High.
nodes.eli5: Comparing this week checkup to last week to see what is new, fixed, or still broken.

nodes.label: Constraints: Pace + Quality
nodes.short_def: Limits on publishing volume and change size to avoid instability.
nodes.why_important: Pacing and QA reduce self-inflicted regressions and protect trust.

nodes.label: Content Creation Decisions
nodes.short_def: When to create a burst, a single support post, or a new pillar+cluster.
nodes.why_important: Content is the primary lever to push clusters from positions 8–20 into top 10.

nodes.label: Cross-Page Updates
nodes.short_def: Update existing relevant pages to link to the new content.
nodes.why_important: Creates bidirectional reinforcement and avoids orphaned spokes.

nodes.label: Daily Content PR
nodes.short_def: One PR per day for content actions.
nodes.why_important: Creates a consistent shipping rhythm and a clean review trail.

nodes.label: Daily Loop (Content + Quick Fixes)
nodes.short_def: Day-to-day ranking-driven decisions that produce 0–1 content PR/day (optionally 2).
nodes.why_important: Daily actions capture momentum when keywords sit near page 1 or get stuck.

nodes.label: DataForSEO (Rankings + SERP)
nodes.short_def: Daily rank positions and SERP snapshots (top results, PAA, related searches, features).
nodes.why_important: Acts as the daily ranking truth and supplies SERP context for decisions and snippet fixes.

nodes.label: Decision System
nodes.short_def: Clarity rules that map filtered signals to specific action types.
nodes.why_important: A simple rule set prevents overthinking and keeps execution consistent across days.

nodes.label: Execution Pipelines
nodes.short_def: How chosen actions become shipped changes: content pipeline + tech pipeline.
nodes.why_important: Reliable pipelines reduce errors and keep output consistent (posts, refreshes, fixes).

nodes.label: Expand Keyword Set
nodes.short_def: Detect and add new clusters/themes that the site should track.
nodes.why_important: Expanding the keyword set is how the system finds new growth vectors.

nodes.label: Feedback & Recalibration
nodes.short_def: Use outcomes to update tracked keywords, thresholds, and the content roadmap.
nodes.why_important: The system improves only if it learns (what moves rankings, what improves CTR, what breaks).

nodes.label: GSC/Analytics (CTR + Conversions)
nodes.short_def: Query/page performance to detect CTR and conversion regressions.
nodes.why_important: Separates ranking success from business success and triggers snippet/CTR actions.

nodes.label: Generate Posts + Links
nodes.short_def: Produce the support content and required internal links.
nodes.why_important: Links are part of the action, not an afterthought.

nodes.label: Goal: Compounding Organic Visibility
nodes.short_def: Improve rankings/visibility by continuously expanding and updating topical authority.
nodes.why_important: Authority compounds through consistent publishing, linking, and upkeep.

nodes.label: High-Value Filter (Volume/Business)
nodes.short_def: Prioritize by search volume and business value thresholds.
nodes.why_important: Prevents spending cycles on low-impact queries when higher leverage exists.

nodes.label: Internal Linking Discipline
nodes.short_def: Systematic linking from spokes to pillars and updating relevant pages.
nodes.why_important: Internal linking compounds authority and reduces orphan pages.

nodes.label: Key Repos & Boundaries
nodes.short_def: Where ongoing SEO work is executed and versioned.
nodes.why_important: Clear boundaries prevent drift between research, writing, and site code changes.

nodes.label: Linkable Asset
nodes.short_def: A deliberately designed asset meant to earn backlinks and unlock ranking plateaus.
nodes.why_important: If content is strong but authority is flat, assets are higher leverage than more spokes.

nodes.label: Max Posts Per Day
nodes.short_def: Enforce 0–1 post/day (optionally 2) across the site.
nodes.why_important: Protects crawl/index stability and prevents quality drops.

nodes.label: Merge + Monitor
nodes.short_def: Merge changes, then monitor signals for impact.
nodes.why_important: The loop closes only when outcomes are observed and captured.

nodes.label: Monitor Outcomes
nodes.short_def: Observe rank changes, CTR changes, and business outcomes after shipping.
nodes.why_important: Outcomes determine whether rules and content direction are working.

nodes.label: Movers Filter (≥3 Positions)
nodes.short_def: Detect keywords/pages that materially moved since yesterday/7d.
nodes.why_important: Movement is a signal of active SERP volatility or algorithmic response to changes.

nodes.label: Near Page 1 Filter (Positions 8–20)
nodes.short_def: Focus on queries close enough to break into page 1 with supporting content or refreshes.
nodes.why_important: Near-page-1 work usually has the highest marginal impact per post.

nodes.label: New Cluster Detection
nodes.short_def: Spot new themes in weekly wide scans and SERP patterns.
nodes.why_important: Creates opportunities for new pillars and fresh clusters.

nodes.label: New: Pillar + Cluster
nodes.short_def: Create a new pillar plus 6–8 spokes when a new theme emerges.
nodes.why_important: New clusters are the main path to expanding what the site can rank for over time.

nodes.label: Operating Cadence
nodes.short_def: Two rhythms: daily content loop and weekly technical recalibration.
nodes.why_important: A fixed cadence prevents neglect (no maintenance) and thrash (too many changes).

nodes.label: PR Cadence Governance
nodes.short_def: Ship changes as PRs with daily/weekly expectations.
nodes.why_important: PR cadence enforces batching discipline and makes changes reviewable.

nodes.label: Page Improvement Decisions
nodes.short_def: When to refresh a page or improve CTR/snippets.
nodes.why_important: Refreshing protects existing wins and recovers losses without creating more pages.

nodes.label: Pause/Slow Publishing
nodes.short_def: Reduce publishing when tech health or conversion health regresses.
nodes.why_important: Stabilization prevents compounding harm while root causes are fixed.

nodes.label: Primary Signal Sources
nodes.short_def: The recurring inputs that drive the autopilot loop.
nodes.why_important: Signal quality determines decision quality; define a consistent daily truth source and cross-checks.

nodes.label: Quality Gates
nodes.short_def: Verification steps that prevent shipping low-quality or incorrect content.
nodes.why_important: Quality failures erode trust and can trigger ranking regression.

nodes.label: Queue & Scheduling
nodes.short_def: How work orders are queued and drip-published within pacing limits.
nodes.why_important: Scheduling turns bursts into predictable daily output without overwhelm.

nodes.label: Rank Movement Tracking
nodes.short_def: Day-to-day and week-to-week movement buckets and drop alerts.
nodes.why_important: Supports refresh and burst timing decisions.

nodes.label: Rank Positions (Daily Truth)
nodes.short_def: Keyword → position + ranking URL for tracked clusters.
nodes.why_important: This is the primary feedback signal that the loop optimizes for each day.

nodes.label: Refine Work Orders
nodes.short_def: Improve work order templates and decision mapping as patterns emerge.
nodes.why_important: Clearer work orders reduce execution errors and speed up throughput.

nodes.label: Refresh: Update Existing Page
nodes.short_def: Update sections, add FAQs, and improve recency when rankings drop.
nodes.why_important: Refreshing is the fastest way to recover drops when tech health is clean.

nodes.label: Repo: blog_writer
nodes.short_def: The controlled content generation pipeline used to write/support posts.
nodes.why_important: Standardizes writing quality and linking behavior across daily work orders.

nodes.label: Repo: mybcat-new
nodes.short_def: The website code/content repo where changes land via PRs.
nodes.why_important: PR-based delivery provides traceability, review, and rollback for SEO changes.

nodes.label: Root Concept
nodes.short_def: A signal-driven operating system for ongoing SEO on mybcat.com: daily content decisions + weekly technical maintenance.
nodes.why_important: Turns rankings and site-health changes into consistent, high-leverage actions without random publishing.
nodes.deep_dive: Core loop: check signals (rankings/SERP/audit/CTR) → decide using clarity rules → act via work orders → ship PRs → learn and recalibrate tracked keywords and thresholds.
nodes.example: If a cluster has 3+ keywords in positions 8–20 and improving, create a burst of 3–5 spokes and drip publish (max 1–2 posts/day) while keeping weekly tech health clean.
nodes.eli5: Look at what is happening in Google, decide what to write or fix, then do it every day/week.

nodes.label: SERP Context (Features + Questions)
nodes.short_def: PAA questions, related searches, feature blocks, and top competitors.
nodes.why_important: Explains why the SERP behaves as it does and supplies targets for refresh/CTR actions.

nodes.label: Scope: Content + Tech Actions
nodes.short_def: Two levers: publish/support content and remove technical blockers.
nodes.why_important: SEO performance is constrained by both relevance (content) and crawl/index health (tech).

nodes.label: Signal Filters
nodes.short_def: Rules that decide which keywords/pages deserve attention today.
nodes.why_important: Filters focus effort on the highest probability of movement (near page 1, movers, high value).

nodes.label: Signal-Driven SEO Autopilot
nodes.short_def: A repeatable check → decide → act loop for ongoing SEO.
nodes.why_important: Creates compounding progress by acting on the right signals at the right time.

nodes.label: Signals & Measurements
nodes.short_def: What we observe: rankings, SERP context, CTR, site health, and authority changes.
nodes.why_important: Without reliable measurement, content and fixes become random and hard to evaluate.

nodes.label: Single: One Support Post
nodes.short_def: Create one targeted support post when a keyword is stuck 11–20.
nodes.why_important: A single spoke can resolve a missing intent slice and add internal link pressure.

nodes.label: Site Health + Authority Signals
nodes.short_def: Audit issues, broken links, redirect chains, and backlink deltas.
nodes.why_important: Distinguishes content problems from technical/authority problems when rankings move.

nodes.label: Site: mybcat.com
nodes.short_def: The target property whose organic visibility and conversions we are improving.
nodes.why_important: Defines the audience, constraints, and what counts as success.

nodes.label: Spoke → Pillar Links
nodes.short_def: Every support post links to the pillar it is meant to lift.
nodes.why_important: Makes topical clusters explicit to search engines and users.

nodes.label: System Risk Decisions
nodes.short_def: When to prioritize tech fixes, consolidation, or to slow publishing.
nodes.why_important: Risk controls prevent regressions like crawl waste, indexability issues, and cannibalization.

nodes.label: Tech Integrity Gate
nodes.short_def: Check for technical causes before refreshing content after large drops.
nodes.why_important: Fixing the wrong thing wastes time; tech issues can suppress otherwise strong pages.

nodes.label: Tracked Keywords Maintenance
nodes.short_def: Keep the tracked keyword set current and clustered.
nodes.why_important: Tracking accuracy determines whether the loop sees the right signals.

nodes.label: Tune Rules & Thresholds
nodes.short_def: Adjust filters, thresholds, and work order definitions over time.
nodes.why_important: Rules must evolve as the site grows and SERPs change.

nodes.label: Weekly Loop (Technical + Recalibration)
nodes.short_def: Weekly maintenance to keep indexability/link health stable and detect new clusters.
nodes.why_important: Technical regression can erase content gains; weekly scans prevent silent decay.

nodes.label: Weekly Refresh PR (Optional)
nodes.short_def: A separate PR for batch refreshes when needed.
nodes.why_important: Separating refreshes from tech fixes preserves clarity and review speed.

nodes.label: Weekly SEO Site Audit
nodes.short_def: Run comprehensive technical + on-page SEO audit to detect issues proactively.
nodes.why_important: Proactive issue detection prevents ranking drops before they happen; complements reactive signal-based approach.
nodes.deep_dive: Weekly audit covers: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, meta tags, headings, internal links, schema markup, and content quality. Findings are compared against baseline to identify new, persistent, and resolved issues.
nodes.example: Audit detects missing meta description on /pricing/ page - creates work order to fix before it affects rankings.
nodes.eli5: Like a weekly health checkup for your website - find problems before they get serious.

nodes.label: Weekly Tech Fix PR
nodes.short_def: One PR per week dedicated to technical maintenance fixes.
nodes.why_important: Keeps audit health stable so content gains are not suppressed.

nodes.label: Work Order Types
nodes.short_def: A small vocabulary that encodes the chosen action (create, refresh, fix).
nodes.why_important: A shared vocabulary makes the system auditable and automatable.

nodes.label: Work Orders & Pacing
nodes.short_def: Structured action representations (work orders) plus strict publishing limits.
nodes.why_important: Work orders turn decisions into executable tasks while pacing prevents site-wide chaos.

nodes.label: blog_writer Content Pipeline
nodes.short_def: The standardized pipeline for generating posts from work orders.
nodes.why_important: Keeps writing quality and internal linking consistent while scaling output.

nodes.label: mybcat-new Delivery Pipeline
nodes.short_def: The PR-based workflow that lands content and fixes into the site repo.
nodes.why_important: Ensures every change is reviewable and deployable.

edges.why: Work orders must be executed through reliable pipelines to produce correct outputs.
edges.how: Feed work orders into content and tech pipelines that generate posts, refreshes, or fixes.

edges.why: Shipping changes is not enough; the system must observe outcomes and adapt.

edges.why: Content actions require producing both text and the linking plan.

edges.why: PR packaging is how changes stay reviewable and isolated.

edges.why: Cluster authority requires a clear pillar-spoke structure.

edges.why: Outcomes determine whether the loop is working and where it needs adjustment.

edges.why: Ranking movement is the fastest feedback signal in SEO.

edges.why: Growth requires continuously finding new themes to build authority in.

edges.why: Technical and authority issues accumulate unless reviewed deliberately.

edges.why: The loop exists to drive compounding organic growth over time.

edges.why: Content creation is the primary lever to expand topical authority and move clusters upward.
edges.how: Choose between burst, single support, or new pillar+cluster based on cluster shape and momentum.

edges.why: A single stuck keyword often needs one missing support piece to complete intent coverage.

edges.why: Burst output should be spread out to isolate impact and reduce instability.

edges.why: Technical maintenance must be deliberate and visible.

edges.why: Most actions involve creating or updating content that must meet quality standards.
edges.how: Use the blog_writer pipeline to generate and QA posts from work orders.

edges.why: Quality gates prevent brand and SEO regressions from weak content.
edges.how: Apply structured review before publishing or committing to the site repo.

edges.why: Shipping is only successful if outcomes are observed and recorded.
edges.how: Merge then monitor ranks/CTR/health signals to validate impact.

edges.why: New posts create opportunity to strengthen existing pages through linking.
edges.how: Update relevant existing pages to include links to the new content (and vice versa).

edges.why: New clusters are discovered through wider scans and emerging SERP patterns.

edges.why: Top-10 rank without clicks or conversions is a packaging problem.
edges.how: Use CTR and conversion trends to trigger snippet fixes or throttles.

edges.why: Tracking must stay current or the loop stops seeing the right signals.

edges.why: Clearer work orders reduce execution errors and speed up throughput.

edges.why: On-page elements directly signal relevance to search engines and affect CTR.

edges.why: Historical audit data enables learning and strategy refinement.
edges.how: Persistent vs resolved issues inform which types of optimizations work best.

edges.why: The loop depends on stable signal inputs with clear ownership and cadence.

edges.why: Technical and authority changes can shift rankings independent of content quality.

edges.why: Not all rankings are equally valuable for the business.

edges.why: PR cadence is the mechanism that enforces operational discipline.

edges.why: Internal linking is the reinforcement mechanism that makes clusters compound.
